item.title: Letters To Santa From Bratt Elementary Second Graders
item.description: NorthEscambia.com asked second grade students at Bratt Elementary School to write letters to Santa. The letters have already been forwarded to Santa to make sure he knows all their special wishes. Students in the classes of Mrs. Phillips, Mrs. Estes, and Mrs. Ward wrote letters to Santa. For all of the letters, click here.

item.title: Ransom Middle Students Enjoy PBIS Holiday Celebration
item.description: Ransom Middle School celebrated student achievement lst week with a PBIS Holiday event designed to reward positive behavior. Students donned festive reindeer antlers and holiday lights while gathering to decorate wooden ornaments and stars. Along with the crafts, students enjoyed a cookies and refreshments. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.

item.title: See ‘The Polar Express’ Tonight At Century Library’s Family Movie Night
item.description: Monday night is Family Movie Night at the Century Library. “The Polar Express” will be shown at 5 p.m.. The movie is Rated G with a runtime of 1:40. The Century Library is located at 7991 North Century Boulevard. Admission is free.
